title.en: Trump says US to scale back military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
title.zh: 特朗普表示，在韩国退出伊朗战争后，美国将缩减与韩国的军事演习

summary.en: His decision to reduce the partnership came after South Korea recently declined to aid his war effort in Iran.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
President Donald Trump has said the US will "substantially reduce" joint military exercises with South Korea, citing his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader Kim Jong Un.

"These exercises are not only costly, with much of these costs paid for by the United States of America (as usual!), but send a signal that is totally inappropriate and hostile," Trump wrote on Truth Social on Sunday.

He also noted that South Korea had recently declined to join the US in the "denuclearisation" of Iran.

The decision comes after Pyongyang this month conducted ballistic missile tests that are banned by the United Nations.

Trump said in his social media post that it was "too late to cancel", as the US and South Korea were due to start their annual military exercises on Monday.

He added: "While somewhat unrelated (?), I recently asked the President of South Korea if they would like to join us in the Denuclearization of the Islamic Republic of Iran, and they said, 'No thanks!'"

Last week, US and South Korean military leaders held a joint press conference announcing Ulchi Freedom Shield.

They said the 11-day event would be similar in scale to previous years, with about 18,000 South Korean soldiers participating.

During the news conference, military leaders also mentioned North Korea's deployment of troops to aid Russia's war against Ukraine.

US military spokesperson Ryan Donald said "our training accounts for that threat", referring to North Korean soldiers returning from the battlefield.

North Korea's foreign ministry commented on the joint drills on Friday, reiterating its rejection of any threat or challenge by exercising its right to self-defence.

The joint exercises come days after South Korea, the US and Japan detected the second North Korean missile test in days.

Pyongyang has accelerated efforts to expand its nuclear and missile programmes since the collapse in 2019 of Kim's high-profile diplomacy with Trump during his first term in the White House.

He became the first ever sitting US president to set foot in North Korea when he visited seven years ago.

title.en: Trump's envoy Kushner meets with Hamas leader in push to revive Gaza peace plan
title.zh: 特朗普特使库什纳会见哈马斯领导人，推动重振加沙和平计划

summary.en: Trump's peace plan foresees Hamas disarming as Israeli troops withdraw from Gaza.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump's son-in-law and envoy Jared Kushner met Hamas's new leader in Egypt overnight in a push to revive a Gaza peace plan rejected by Israel.

Two weeks after Hamas endorsed the latest stage of Trump's Gaza pla n by saying it would hand over weapons to a new governing committee, Kushner pressed for verifiable disarmament, a key demand of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Netanyahu on 9 August rejected the Gaza peace plan , saying Trump's latest roadmap for peace was "unacceptable".

Hamas chief Khalil al-Hayya took part in the discussions in the Egyptian Mediterranean city of El-Alamein, making his first trip since assuming leadership of the group in July .

In talks with Kushner, Hamas again voiced its commitment to the plan, a source familiar with the talks told Agence France-Presse.

The group said afterwards that it had called on mediators and Trump's so-called Board of Peace to "compel" Israel to "approve the roadmap ... and begin establishing a timetable for its implementation".

A picture released by host Egypt did not include al-Hayya, but showed Kushner at a table alongside members of the Board of Peace, including former UK Prime Minister Tony Blair. Qatar and Türkiye, key mediators alongside Egypt, also joined.

The United States for years refused contact with Hamas, but the Trump administration has increasingly been comfortable with direct contact in hopes of ending the devastating conflict, negotiating the October ceasefire agreement.

Kushner on Monday will see Netanyahu, a longtime hawk who faces a tough re-election fight in October.

The three regional mediator countries and five other countries — Jordan, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Pakistan and Indonesia — on Sunday condemned Israel's rejection of the plan.

In a joint statement, they said "Israel bears direct and full responsibility" for obstructing peace, adding that its refusal "directly threatens to derail extensive efforts" by Trump.

In response, Netanyahu's Likud Party charged that "the Arab countries want to bring down the prime minister" in the election.

The inclusion of the United Arab Emirates is significant as it normalised relations with Israel five years ago.

Netanyahu expressed opposition to the US plan even after he was assured by Nickolay Mladenov, the Board of Peace's high representative for Gaza, that Israel would not need to pull troops out of the war-battered territory until complete disarmament by Hamas.

The board had initially said Israel would start a phased withdrawal in tandem with Hamas's disarmament.

title.en: US commander says mental health a 'priority' on USS Lincoln
title.zh: 美国指挥官称心理健康是林肯号航空母舰的“优先事项”

summary.en: Adm Brad Cooper acknowledged that navy service at sea for long periods is "uniquely challenging and tough", following a visit to the warship.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The top US military commander in the Middle East has said mental health is a "priority" on the warship USS Lincoln, following reports of difficult conditions on board the long-deployed ship.

After visiting the vessel on Saturday, Adm Brad Cooper said it had "among the lowest number of cases related to mental health" out of 11 active US aircraft carriers.

But he acknowledged that Navy service at sea for long periods was "uniquely challenging and tough".

The ship arrived in the Middle East in January and has been supporting the US war against Iran, including the blockade on Iranian ports. It has spent a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea of more than 240 days.

The USS George Washington is currently heading to replace the USS Lincoln and could arrive in the region in about a week.

Family members of sailors aboard the Lincoln have expressed concern about their mental health deteriorating due to the conditions, with some sailors having reportedly attempted to jump overboard.

Adm Cooper said in a statement on Sunday: "I've long believed that mental health is another aspect of individual health and requires our attention just like physical health and spiritual health.

"I applaud Lincoln's leadership for... stepping up and making mental health and crew resilience a leadership priority."

While the US Navy last week acknowledged supply challenges, it had denied a mental health crisis on the Lincoln, which has 5,000 people aboard.

Conditions aboard the ship have included poor sanitation, infrequent ports-of-call, broken plumbing and shortages of fresh food, according to reports last week in the Military Times and Stars & Stripes.

Thirteen Democrats on the Senate Armed Services Committee sent a letter on Saturday to Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, criticising the length of the deployment as "a modern-day record" and demanding answers.

Last week, Hegseth called reports of conditions "completely misrepresented", while President Donald Trump dismissed suggestions the sailors had been at sea too long, telling reporters on Friday: "Not nearly long enough."

The USS Lincoln deployment, which was originally set to end in May, has been repeatedly extended. The personnel have reportedly been at sea without a port call for over 200 consecutive days.

Maryland's Democratic Governor Wes Moore, a US Army veteran, told CNN on Sunday that the reported conditions were "heartbreaking" and the Republican president should have "more compassion".
body.zh: 在有报道称这艘长期部署的林肯号军舰上状况不佳后，美国驻中东最高军事指挥官表示，心理健康是这艘军舰的“首要任务”。 布拉德·库珀上将周六视察这艘航母后表示，在美国 11 艘现役航空母舰中，该航母是“与心理健康相关的病例数最少的航母之一”。 但他承认，海军长期在海上服役是“独特的挑战和艰难”。 该船于一月抵达中东，一直支持美国对伊朗的战争，包括封锁伊朗港口。它已创纪录地在海上不间断航行了240多天。 乔治·华盛顿号航空母舰目前正在取代林肯号航空母舰，并可能在大约一周内抵达该地区。 林肯号上水手的家人对他们的心理健康状况因这种情况恶化表示担忧，据报道，一些水手试图跳海。 库珀上将在周日的一份声明中表示：“我一直相信心理健康是个人健康的另一个方面，就像身体健康和精神健康一样需要我们的关注。 “我赞扬林肯的领导……加紧努力，将心理健康和船员复原力作为领导优先事项。” 尽管美国海军上周承认供应方面存在挑战，但否认林肯号上有心理健康危机，船上有 5,000 人。 据《军事时报》和《星条旗报》上周报道，船上的条件包括卫生条件差、停靠港不频繁、管道破损和新鲜食品短缺。 参议院军事委员会的 13 名民主党人周六致函国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯，批评部署时间为“现代记录”，并要求得到答复。 上周，赫格斯称有关情况的报道“完全歪曲”，而唐纳德·特朗普总统则驳斥了水手们在海上停留时间过长的说法，并于周五告诉记者：“时间还不够长。” 林肯号航空母舰的部署原定于5月结束，现已多次延长。据报道，这些人员已连续200多天在海上没有停靠港口。 马里兰州民主党州长、美国退伍军人韦斯·摩尔周日告诉美国有线电视新闻网，报道的情况“令人心碎”，共和党总统应该有“更多的同情心”。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到对脆弱群体的怜悯。Galatians 6:2提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以具体的怜悯与接纳来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

title.en: Belgian wildfire doubles in size on third day tearing through nature reserve
title.zh: 比利时野火第三天面积翻倍，肆虐自然保护区

summary.en: Hundreds of firefighters are trying to contain the flames consuming the major park.
summary.zh: 数百名消防员正努力扑灭吞噬这座主要公园的火焰。

body.en:
A wildfire described as the largest in Belgium's recent history has more than doubled in size in 24 hours, local officials said on Sunday.

Hundreds of firefighters are spending a third day beating back flames tearing through Hautes Fagnes - the country's largest nature reserve - prompting the evacuation of two nearby villages.

Local farmers hauled water tankers towards the park near Belgium's eastern border with Germany, backed by water-bombing aircraft and helicopters sent from Sweden and the Netherlands.

The blaze is one of several wildfires reported across Europe this weekend, with at least two killed in forest fires on a Greek island off the coast of Athens on Sunday.

Belgian officials have warned that high heat and the park's terrain - which consists of bog-like territory, moorland and forests - have hampered efforts to extinguish the fire.

It spread from 80 hectares (200 acres) on Friday to 850 hectares on Saturday morning - before consuming 3,000 hectares by early Sunday, AFP news agency reported citing local officials.

Belgian Interior Minister Bernard Quintin said two of its fronts - heading towards Jalhay and Monschau - had been brought under control.

But the blaze continued to advance on Sunday, with its active front reported to be a kilometre long.

Authorities earlier said the conditions remained challenging and that they were relying heavily on aerial assistance to tame the flames, though no homes have been affected.

Two water-bombing aircraft arrived from Sweden on Sunday afternoon to back up four helicopters - two Belgian and two Dutch - already on site.

Nicolas Yernaux, spokesman for the regional authorities in Wallonia, had said on Saturday that the fire was the country's "largest in recent history".

Firefighters had "allowed parts of the heathland to burn because the area is very difficult to access", he added.

Rescue teams have been unable to access the area where fire broke out, meaning its cause remains unknown.

Forest fires have also been reported in Croatia, Spain and Serbia since Friday, after a summer of extreme heat that has seen swathes of land across Europe either going up in flames or being scorched brown .

Local officials in Landes, south-western France said a wildfire had triggered the evacuation of 650 residents on Saturday.

The fire began on Thursday and, according to authorities, reignited on Saturday - with more than 500 firefighters deployed to tackle the blaze.

The EU's climate monitoring service, Copernicus, has confirmed that western Europe experienced its hottest June-to-July period on record.
body.zh: 当地官员周日表示，一场被描述为比利时近期历史上最大的野火，其规模在 24 小时内扩大了一倍多。 数百名消防员连续第三天奋力扑灭该国最大的自然保护区上法涅斯的大火，导致附近两个村庄的人员疏散。 当地农民在瑞典和荷兰派出的水轰炸机和直升机的支援下，将水罐车拖向比利时东部与德国边境附近的公园。 这场大火是欧洲本周末报道的几起野火之一，周日，雅典海岸附近的一个希腊岛屿发生森林火灾，造成至少两人死亡。 比利时官员警告说，高温和公园的地形（由沼泽地、沼泽地和森林组成）阻碍了灭火工作。 据法新社援引当地官员的消息称，受灾面积从周五的 80 公顷（200 英亩）扩大到周六早上的 850 公顷，到周日早些时候已经消耗了 3,000 公顷。 比利时内政部长伯纳德·昆廷表示，其两条战线——前往贾莱和蒙绍——已经得到控制。 但周日火势继续蔓延，据报道火势长达一公里。 当局早些时候表示，情况仍然充满挑战，他们严重依赖空中援助来控制火势，但没有房屋受到影响。 周日下午，两架水轰炸机从瑞典抵达，为已经在现场的四架直升机（两架比利时和两架荷兰）提供支援。 瓦隆地区当局发言人尼古拉斯·耶诺(Nicolas Yernaux)周六表示，这场火灾是该国“近代历史上最大的火灾”。 他补充说，消防队员“允许部分石南荒地燃烧，因为该地区很难进入”。 救援队无法进入起火地区，这意味着起火原因仍不清楚。 自周五以来，克罗地亚、西班牙和塞尔维亚也报告发生森林火灾，经历了一个夏季的酷热，欧洲大片土地要么着火，要么被烧焦。 法国西南部朗德市当地官员表示，周六，一场山火已导致 650 名居民疏散。 据当局称，大火于周四开始，并于周六重新燃起，并部署了 500 多名消防员来扑灭大火。 欧盟气候监测服务机构哥白尼证实，西欧经历了有记录以来最热的六月至七月时期。

reflection.en: The expanding wildfire in the nature reserve reminds us of creation's vulnerability and the deep pain it endures. As the earth groans under such devastation, it calls us to reflect on our role in its care and restoration, trusting in Yahweh's ultimate renewal.
reflection.zh: 自然保护区内不断蔓延的野火提醒我们，受造界是如此脆弱，它正承受着深切的痛苦。当地球在这样的破坏下呻吟时，这呼唤我们反思自己在照管和恢复它方面的角色，并信靠雅伟最终的更新。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Republican senator denounces Trump’s ‘crazy, stupid’ claims about MMR vaccine safety
title.zh: 共和党参议员谴责特朗普关于麻腮风疫苗安全性的“疯狂、愚蠢”言论

When Trump recently ordered changes to the recommended childhood vaccination schedule, with Kennedy by his side, the president called for two shots of the combined Measles, Mumps and Rubella vaccine to be scrapped in favor of two doses of three separate vaccines, claiming that the MMR shots are “sort of like a nuclear weapon” that could be “quite lethal”. reflection.en: In public discourse, especially concerning health, the call to speak truth and reject falsehood is vital. Senator Cassidy's denouncement of claims he deems "crazy, stupid" highlights the responsibility of leaders and experts to uphold factual integrity. This reminds us that Yahweh calls us to put away deceit and speak truthfully with one another.
reflection.zh: 在公共讨论中，尤其是在涉及健康问题时，说真话、摒弃谎言至关重要。卡西迪参议员谴责他认为“疯狂、愚蠢”的言论，突显了领导者和专家维护事实诚信的责任。这提醒我们，雅伟呼召我们弃绝谎言，与邻舍说实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
title.zh: 特朗普特使库什纳会见哈马斯领导人以推动加沙和平计划

summary.en: A rare meeting occurred between Trump envoy Jared Kushner and a Hamas leader to advance a peace plan for Gaza, following Israel's rejection of the proposed plan a week prior.

body.en:
US President Donald Trump's Middle East envoy Jared Kushner has held rare talks with Hamas to discuss the implementation of the US-backed Gaza peace plan.

A Palestinian official told the BBC Trump's son-in-law met a delegation led by Hamas's new leader Khalil al-Hayya in Egypt on Sunday.

Last month, Trump's Board of Peace said it had reached agreement for the "complete disarmament" of Hamas and other armed group in Gaza. Last week, Israel rejected Trump's 15-point plan which also calls for Israeli troops to withdraw and for Gaza to be rebuilt under a new civilian Palestinian administration.

Eight Muslim countries issued a statement on Sunday condemning Israel's rejection.

Trump leads the Board of Peace - created as an international organisation originally intended to bring peace to Gaza, but later expanded to include conflicts worldwide.

Kushner's meeting with Hayya is said to be the first at this level since last year's agreement of a ceasefire for the Gaza Strip.

According to reports, Board of Peace envoys Nickolay Mladenov and UK ex-Prime Minister Tony Blair were also part of the meeting - alongside representatives of Egypt, Qatar and Turkey, which have mediated in the peace efforts.

No official statement has been released of the talks reportedly focusing on concrete actions to decommission Hamas's weapons - as well as the withdrawal of Israeli troops and humanitarian efforts.

Whilst in Egypt, Kushner also met Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi. According to Israeli media reports, Kushner, Mladenov and Blair will meet Netanyahu on Monday with the aim of advancing Trump's plan.

The Israeli prime minister has said he wants a full Hamas disarmament first in order to implement the deal.

"Israel rejects the Board of Peace's 15-point document on Gaza. The IDF will not carry out any withdrawal until Hamas is genuinely disarmed," Netanyahu said last week defying Israel's closest ally.

In a joint statement on Sunday, Egypt, UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Turkey, Pakistan and Indonesia said Israel's rejection of the US plan threatened Trump's efforts for peace.

The ceasefire, which came into effect on 10 October last year, remains in place.

However, the Israel Defense Forces have carried out several strikes in Gaza since then - the latest on "terrorists" in Khan Yunis and Nuseirat areas of Gaza - accusing Hamas of breaking the truce.

The war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, in which about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage.

Israel responded to the attack by launching a military campaign in Gaza, during which more than 73,000 people have been killed, according to the territory's health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN.

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的中东特使贾里德·库什纳与哈马斯举行了罕见的会谈，讨论美国支持的加沙和平计划的实施。 一名巴勒斯坦官员告诉BBC，特朗普的女婿周日在埃及会见了哈马斯领导人哈利勒·哈亚率领的代表团。 上个月，特朗普的和平委员会表示，已就哈马斯和加沙其他武装组织“彻底解除武装”达成协议。上周，以色列拒绝了特朗普的15点计划，该计划还呼吁以色列军队撤军，并在新的巴勒斯坦文职政府领导下重建加沙。 八个穆斯林国家周日发表声明，谴责以色列的拒绝。 特朗普领导和平委员会 - 作为一个国际组织成立，最初旨在为加沙带来和平，但后来扩大到包括世界范围内的冲突。 据称，库什纳与哈亚的会晤是自去年加沙地带停火协议以来的首次此类会议。 据报道，和平委员会特使尼古拉·姆拉德诺夫和英国前首相托尼·布莱尔也参加了会议，还有埃及、卡塔尔和土耳其的代表，他们在和平努力中进行了调解。 据报道，会谈的重点是使哈马斯武器退役的具体行动，以及以色列撤军和人道主义努力，但尚未发布任何官方声明。 在埃及期间，库什纳还会见了埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西。据以色列媒体报道，库什纳、姆拉德诺夫和布莱尔将于周一会见内塔尼亚胡，旨在推进特朗普的计划。 以色列总理表示，他希望哈马斯首先全面解除武装，以执行该协议。 “以色列拒绝和平委员会关于加沙的15点文件。在哈马斯真正解除武装之前，以色列国防军不会进行任何撤军，”内塔尼亚胡上周无视以色列最亲密的盟友表示。 埃及、阿联酋、卡塔尔、沙特阿拉伯、约旦、土耳其、巴基斯坦和印度尼西亚在周日的联合声明中表示，以色列拒绝美国的计划威胁到特朗普的和平努力。 去年10月10日生效的停火协议仍然有效。 然而，此后以色列国防军对加沙进行了多次袭击——最近一次是针对加沙汗尤尼斯和努塞拉特地区的“恐怖分子”——指责哈马斯破坏停火协议。 这场战争是由哈马斯领导的 2023 年 10 月 7 日对以色列南部的袭击引发的，袭击造成约 1,200 人死亡，另有 251 人被劫持为人质。 以色列对加沙的袭击作出回应，根据该地区卫生部的说法，在这场军事行动中，已有超过 73,000 人被杀。联合国认为该部门的数据是可靠的。 联合国估计，大约...

reflection.en: In complex geopolitical situations, the pursuit of peace often requires persistent effort and engagement with all parties involved. Yahweh's word encourages us to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, even when previous attempts have faced rejection.
reflection.zh: 在复杂的地缘政治局势中，追求和平往往需要持续的努力，并与所有相关方进行接触。雅伟的话语鼓励我们，只要力所能及，就与众人和睦相处，即使先前的尝试曾遭到拒绝。

title.en: Two dead and hundreds evacuated after twin fires break out on Greek island
title.zh: 希腊岛屿发生两起火灾，造成两人死亡，数百人被疏散

summary.en: Two people have died and hundreds were evacuated after two fires broke out on the Greek island of Salamina. About 200 firefighters are working to prevent the fires from merging, with one now under control.
summary.zh: 希腊萨拉米纳岛发生两起火灾，造成两人死亡，数百人被疏散。约200名消防员正在努力阻止火势蔓延，其中一起火灾已得到控制。

body.en:
Two people died and and hundreds were evacuated after two fires broke out "almost simultaneously" on a Greek island near Athens on Sunday afternoon, officials said.

About 200 firefighters were deployed to keep the twin fires from converging on the island of Salamina, which was under a high wildfire risk on Sunday.

The first blaze was reported at 14:40 local time (11:40 GMT) near the island's south coast and spread rapidly due to high winds, followed by a separate fire some 20 minutes later in the east. Their cause is not yet known.

One of the fires had been brought under control and evacuations completed by Sunday evening, Greek media report, with 500 people having left the island by sea.

The first blaze broke out in a forested residential area in Peristeria, a southern city on the island, fire official Vasilios Vathrakoyannis said in a statement.

Firefighters attending the blaze found two bodies at the scene, he said. The city's mayor told Greek media they were believed to have been a couple.

Officials continued to battle scattered blazes there late on Sunday, while the second fire which began in the eastern town of Selinia was said to have "no active front".

Two coast guard vessels and a fire department vessel will remain in the area for surveillance and assistance.

At least 10 other people suffered burns or showed "symptoms of smoke inhalation", five of whom had been taken for treatment locally, Greek Health Minister Adonis Georgiades said on X.

A number of aircraft and 50 fire engines, assisted by water tankers and construction machinery, were deployed to try and tackle the two fires.

Salamina Deputy Mayor Thodoris Zannis earlier said this was to keep the fires from burning over a mountain on the island and meeting to form a single blaze.

Five patrol boats and several other private vessels were sent to the area for assistance.

Salamina sits just west of Athens and has some 37,000 residents, many of them elderly.

Firefighters across Europe have been facing a series of wildfires this weekend, including officers in Belgium spending a third day beating back flames in the country's largest nature reserve, Hautes Fagnes.

The wildfire - described as the largest in the country's recent history - has more than doubled in size in 24 hours.

Meanwhile, at least one person died and dozens were injured in a wildfire that tore through Croatia's coastline overnight on Friday.

It was described by Croatia's fire chief Slavko Tucakovic as "one of the worst" blazes in the country's history and saw around 1,200 residents and tourists evacuated.

The EU's climate monitoring service, Copernicus, has confirmed that western Europe experienced its hottest June-to-July period on record.

Thirty years after the United States artist, considered one of the most influential rappers of all time, was gunned down in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, the unsolved killing could finally be brought closer to an answer.

Duane "Keffe D" Davis , 63, is standing trial in Las Vegas, accused of orchestrating the killing and providing the gun used in the shooting.

He has pleaded not guilty to murder, with jury selection underway and opening statements expected this week.

But whether the jury returns a guilty verdict or not, the trial is about more than just a cold case murder.

Known for hits like California Love and the top-selling record All Eyez on Me, Shakur was already one of the biggest stars in hip-hop when he was killed at just 25.

Like other young artists whose lives were cut short, his unresolved murder transformed him into a global cultural icon, with his life and death continually revisited and theorised decades after his death.

Cathy Scott, then a crime reporter with the Las Vegas Sun, remembers the night Shakur was shot on 7 September 1996 well. She had been tipped off by a homicide detective about the shooting.

"He said, 'Get out of bed and go down to the Las Vegas Strip … a rapper by the name Tupac Shakur was shot,'" the author and journalist tells SBS News.

Shakur was in the passenger seat of a BMW, driven by music executive Marion "Suge" Knight, when a white Cadillac pulled up next to them at a red light and opened fire.

Scott says police were initially reluctant to share information about their investigation, with one detective telling her they were concerned the suspected gang-related killing was bad for tourism.

"I really think they thought it would go away," Scott, who later wrote a book about the murder, says.

"The less the police department talked about it, and were open about it to reporters, the more reporters covered it."

The murder came amid a bitter rivalry between the East and West Coast hip-hop scenes.

Shakur had signed with Los Angeles-based Death Row Records, co-founded by Knight and then one of hip-hop's most powerful labels. Shakur's rival, fellow rap star Christopher Wallace, known as The Notorious B.I.G. or Biggie Smalls, was signed to Sean "Diddy" Combs' New York-based Bad Boy Records, Death Row's chief rival.

The rivalry between the two labels became intertwined with tensions between rival gangs in Compton, a city in Los Angeles County that had long struggled with gang violence.

title.en: UAE, Saudi Arabia, others condemn Israel's rejection of Trump Gaza plan

body.en:
The statement came as US envoy Jared Kushner and Gaza peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov held ceasefire and implementation talks with regional mediators and Hamas in Egypt.

The United Arab Emirates and seven other countries on Sunday condemned Israel's rejection of President Donald Trump's plan to end the war in the  Gaza Strip .

It comes a week after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected the 15-point plan for Gaza, stating that no military pullout will happen until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

Trump's Board of Peace said last month that it had reached a deal for the complete disarmament of Hamas and other armed groups in Gaza.

The foreign ministers of the UAE, Qatar, Jordan, Indonesia, Pakistan, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Egypt issued their joint statement as Trump's envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, and Nickolay Mladenov, Trump's Board of Peace envoy for Gaza, were in Egypt for Gaza ceasefire-related talks.

Trump announced last month that there had been a breakthrough on a 15-point road map aimed at ending the war in the Gaza Strip.

The plan drawn up by his Board of Peace calls for Israeli troops to withdraw as Hamas gives up its weapons. An international stabilization force would then work alongside a new Palestinian police force to secure Gaza.

"Rejecting the Road Map constitutes an explicit refusal to proceed with the implementation of the Comprehensive Plan, and directly threatens to derail the extensive efforts exerted by US President Trump to bring an end to the war in Gaza and establish the conditions for lasting peace," the foreign ministers said in their Sunday statement.

"Such rejection confirms that Israel now bears responsibility for obstructing the efforts to bring peace in Gaza and the rest of the Occupied Palestinian Territory," they added.

They called on the Board of Peace and the US "to take immediate and concrete measures within its mandate to uphold the integrity of the Comprehensive Plan and prevent any party from obstructing its implementation."

Kushner met Hamas chief, Khalil al-Hayya, on Sunday according to several news agencies citing unnamed sources. 

Kushner and Mladenov were in Egypt and met with mediators from Egypt, Qatar and Turkey to discuss implementation of the deal.

Hamas on July 30 avoided using the term "disarmament," but said it would hand over its weapons to a new Palestinian governing body that would govern Gaza under the supervision of the Board of Peace.

The group, which is designated as a terrorist organization by several countries and the EU, called on mediators and the Board of Peace to "compel" Israel to approve the road map for next steps.

title.en: Ukraine attacks Wildberries, Russia's biggest online market

summary.en: Since mid-July, Ukraine has been targeting warehouses of Russia's largest online retailer Wildberries almost every day. Ukraine says it's disrupting front-line shipments. But experts say it's disrupting Russia's economy.

body.zh: 自7月中旬以来，乌克兰几乎每天都以俄罗斯最大在线零售商Wildberry的仓库为目标。乌克兰表示，前线运输受到干扰。但专家表示，这正在扰乱俄罗斯的经济。 周日早些时候，位于莫斯科以南约 40 公里（25 英里）的波多利斯克镇的俄罗斯最大在线市场 Wildberry 的一个仓库发生火灾。这场火灾是乌克兰无人机夜间大规模袭击造成的，其中大部分无人机被俄罗斯防空系统拦截。 周五，乌克兰袭击了莫斯科北部特维尔的另一个 Wildberry 仓库。前一天，它还纵火焚烧了更东部萨拉瓦特的另一个仓库。 过去几周，大约 20 个 Wildberry 物流中心几乎每天都受到攻击。已确认至少九名员工死亡，数十人受伤，少数仓库已停止运营。 总部位于莫斯科的电子商务咨询公司 Data Insight 估计，Wildberry 已经损失了价值 4800 亿卢布（57 亿美元/49 亿欧元）的商品以及约三分之一的仓库空间。该公司及其卖家的损失估计高达 8000 亿卢布（95 亿美元）。 虽然基辅认为该零售商帮助供应俄罗斯军队，但莫斯科坚称其仅用于民用目的。不管怎样，袭击事件给俄罗斯经济带来了越来越大的压力。 地缘政治咨询公司 Rasmussen Global 首席执行官法布里斯·波蒂尔 (Fabrice Pothier) 告诉德国之声：“我认为（乌克兰）正在寻找一个瓶颈。” “从某种程度上来说，野莓是俄罗斯社会和俄罗斯经济的一个瓶颈。” 2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰并随后对俄罗斯贸易实施制裁后，亚马逊等许多在线电商平台退出了该地区。作为回应，俄罗斯当局允许所谓的平行进口，实质上是允许俄罗斯公司在未经原始权利人同意的情况下进口商品来规避制裁。 这些公司大幅降低传统价格，使其销量猛增。以 Wildberry 为例，其收入在 2021 年至 2025 年间增长了 7 倍。其竞争对手 Ozon 也提供了类似的惊人数字，据报道收入为 4,930 万美元，2025 年将增长 59%。 如今，Wildberry 已成为该国最大的电子商务平台，控制着该国约一半的市场。 Ozon 占据约 30% 的市场份额。它们处理的商品和服务合计相当于俄罗斯国内生产总值 (GDP) 的 8.5% 左右。 继 7 月中旬的最初袭击之后，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 辩称，这些仓库......

title.en: Bus crash in Hungary kills at least 12
title.zh: 匈牙利巴士坠毁，至少12人死亡

summary.en: Police have arrested the driver of a bus that crashed in Hungary, killing at least 12 people. Reports indicated the bus was carrying Polish pilgrims.
summary.zh: 警方表示，一辆在匈牙利坠毁的巴士司机已被逮捕，事故造成至少12人死亡。据报道，该巴士载有波兰朝圣者。

body.en:
Police say they have arrested the driver of a bus that crashed in Hungary, killing at least 12 people. The bus was carrying Polish pilgrims, media report.

At least 12 people have died after a Polish coach crashed into a ditch and overturned in eastern Hungary , police said on Sunday.

According to emergency services, 47 people were injured in the incident, 10 seriously.

The accident occurred on the M3 motorway near Mezokeresztes, around 140 kilometers (87 miles) east of Budapest, according to police in the district capital, Miskolc. 

Police said they believe the driver fell asleep at the wheel during the overnight journey into Sunday. He was subsequently arrested.

Poland's PAP news agency reported that the bus had been carrying a group of pilgrims from Podkarpackie province in the far southeast of Poland .

The group, said to number 59 people, including two drivers, had been returning from Bosnia-Herzegovina , PAP said. 

Hungary's National Directorate for Disaster Management said that several of the passengers had been trapped under the vehicle when it overturned.

  Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar has voiced his condolences to the families of the crash victims in a Facebook message and thanked emergency and rescue services.

Polish President Karol Nawrocki said he was deeply shaken. "In the face of this unimaginable tragedy, which affects us all, my thoughts and prayers go out to the families and loved ones of the victims," the 43-year-old wrote on X.

title.en: Troops from North Korea to boost Russia's Ukraine forces
title.zh: 朝鲜军队将增援俄罗斯在乌克兰的部队

summary.en: Intelligence agencies report that North Korea is preparing to send up to 50,000 troops to Russia to support its forces in Ukraine. However, military experts express skepticism that this deployment will significantly alter the trajectory of the conflict.
summary.zh: 情报机构报告称，朝鲜正准备向俄罗斯派遣多达5万名士兵，以增援其在乌克兰的部队。然而，军事专家们怀疑此举能否从根本上改变俄罗斯与乌克兰战争的进程。

body.en:
Intelligence agencies report that North Korea is preparing to send up to 50,000 troops to Russia. But military experts doubt this will make a fundamental difference in the course of Russia's war with Ukraine.

In late 2024 , North Korea sent troops to help defend the Kursk region of Russia from Ukraine . International officials estimate that 14,000-15,000 North Korean troops were initially deployed to assist Russia in its war in Ukraine .

Now, Ukrainian and international intelligence agencies suspect that North Korea is planning to send an additional 30,000-50,000 troops to Russia . Ukrainian officials have also stated that North Korean ballistic missiles are being fired from Russia.

President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has raised concerns that North Korea's improved combat and weapons experience could pose a security threat to Ukraine, as well as the Asia-Pacific region.

Observers have had mixed responses to Zelenskyy's remarks. Oleksandr Kovalenko, a military and political expert at the Ukrainian Center for Security Studies, told DW that new troops from North Korea would likely be used to secure Russia's border territories. Aside from remaining in Kursk, North Korean soldiers could also help secure southwestern Vornezh.

"These forces could free up Russian occupational forces," Kovalenko said. "Russia would then be able to deploy around 15,000 troops to battles along front lines in Vovchansk, Kharkiv, Sumy or even Chernihiv."

Kovalenko does not expect North Korean troops to fight on Ukrainian territory. 

The Russian military analyst Ruslan Leviev agrees. "It's one thing to recapture Russian territory," he told DW, "and an entirely different thing to be present on internationally recognized Ukrainian territory, taking part in a war of aggression."

"Diplomatically speaking," he said, "those are two entirely different concepts."

Leviev said he had not seen concrete evidence of a noteworthy North Korean presence in Russia. He said Moscow had enough troops available without having to draw foreign soldiers into the fight. 

"If you look at the front line, you can see that Russia's forces have been fairly active since mid-July," Leviev said. "That's a clear sign they still have enough forces."

Estimates by the economist Janis Kluge, of the German Institute for International and Security Affairs, back this up. "While Russia's recruitment campaign has shown signs of strain this year, regional spending figures indicate that Russia is still recruiting around 1,000 contract soldiers each day,"  he recently wrote in a report .

title.en: Lebanon says Israeli strikes kill at least 11​​​ people as hostilities intensify
title.zh: 黎巴嫩称以色列袭击造成至少11人死亡，敌对行动加剧

summary.en: Lebanon's leaders have condemned the strikes, which Israel's military said were in retaliation for an attack by Hezbollah.
summary.zh: 黎巴嫩领导人谴责了这些袭击，以色列军方称这些袭击是对真主党一次袭击的报复。

body.en:
At least 11 people have been killed in Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon, the Lebanese health ministry said, some of the deadliest raids since deals in June eased hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah.

The Israeli military said it struck Hezbollah infrastructure overnight in what it describes as a security zone in southern Lebanon in response to actions against its soldiers there.

Iran-backed Hezbollah said in a statement that the attacks would be "met with what they deserve".

The framework leaves Israeli troops inside occupied southern Lebanon until Hezbollah is disarmed and the Lebanese army takes control, terms the group has rejected as surrender.

Lebanon's official National News Agency said seven people were killed when Israeli warplanes struck a house in the southern village of Ansar, while four others were killed in a strike on the village of Deir El Zahrani.

The seven people killed in Ansar included three children and two women, NNA said, adding that a total of 19 people were wounded in the attacks.

At least 4,300 people have been killed in Lebanon in the latest round of hostilities since 2 March.

NNA also reported other airstrikes across southern Lebanon, including on a strategic area north of the Litani River known as Ali al-Taher hill. One, targeting a valley next to Ansar, was the deepest strike into Lebanon in two months.

The office of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, in a statement on X, accused Hezbollah of violating the ceasefire and attacking Israeli soldiers leading to three injuries.

"The IDF (Israel Defense Forces) responded by striking the Hezbollah terror headquarters which ordered the attack," the statement said. "Only later did the IDF learn that Hezbollah deliberately put civilians in that military compound."

The Israeli military said in a statement it killed Ali Samir Al-Haj Hassan, a commander in Hezbollah's elite Radwan Force unit and others when it struck "a central headquarters of the Radwan Force unit", in Ansar.

"At the time of the strike, Hassan’s family was also present with him inside the military headquarters and, according to the claim, was harmed in the strike," the statement added, emphasising that the family was not the target of the strike.

"The martyrs of the Israeli raid on the village of Ansar are not 'military infrastructure' and the women and children killed in it are not military targets," Lebanon's Prime Minister Nawaf Salam said in a post on X.

title.en: Rescuers search desperately for survivors as Indonesian quake kills dozens of people
title.zh: 印度尼西亚地震造成数十人死亡，救援人员绝望搜寻幸存者

summary.en: Rescue teams are urgently working to reach the region closest to the epicenter of an Indonesian earthquake, where landslides have blocked roads and dozens of people have been killed.
summary.zh: 救援队正紧急赶往印度尼西亚地震震中附近地区，那里山体滑坡阻断了道路，已有数十人遇难。

body.en:
Rescuers have combed through debris for survivors after a powerful earthquake struck off Indonesia's eastern Flores island , killing 48 people and injuring dozens, according to disaster officials.

The national disaster management agency (BNPB) raised the death toll from 40 late on Saturday, and rescue official Fathur Rahman said 50 people were injured in the 7.7-magnitude quake.

Suharyanto, who leads the BNPB, said earlier that people were trapped in several buildings.

"These will be the initial targets of the disaster response teams," said Suharyanto, who like many Indonesians uses one name.

Nearly 160 houses, dozens of educational and health facilities and other public buildings were damaged when the earthquake struck the popular tourist island in Indonesia's east, the BNPB reported.

The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies said preparations were underway to bring aid to some 2,000 people in temporary shelters.

The government sent 50,000 aid packages weighing a total of 275 tonnes to the area, and European Union chief Ursula von der Leyen offered help from the bloc's Copernicus Earth observation satellites.

"Europe stands ready to deploy Copernicus, our eyes in the sky, to support search and rescue efforts. Indonesia, we stand with you," she wrote on X.

"I have never felt an earthquake this big," Yulian Juita Ekalia, who lives in Ruteng city more than 100 kilometres west of the epicentre, told AFP by telephone hours after the tremor.

"It felt like we were on a trampoline; it was really scary," said the 37-year-old university lecturer, who was jolted awake at around 5.30am local time on Saturday.

"As I rushed to get outside, everything in the house fell down: the television, my son's trophies, the dish racks, suitcases on top of the wardrobes. When I got outside, my son and neighbours were already there, screaming in fear."

Rescue official Fathur told AFP the focus was on locating victims who may be buried under rubble, but rescue efforts have been complicated by landslides cutting off roads.

Residents in Nagekeo, an area close to the epicentre, raced for higher ground as the sea retreated early Saturday — a possible sign of an approaching tsunami , AFP journalists witnessed.

While a tsunami warning was lifted, authorities urged people not to return to damaged buildings for fear that aftershocks may bring them down.

Hundreds remained outside hours later as dozens of aftershocks shook the island, the strongest measured at a magnitude of 6.1.

body.zh: 据救灾官员称，印度尼西亚东部弗洛勒斯岛发生强烈地震，造成 48 人死亡、数十人受伤，救援人员正在废墟中搜寻幸存者。 国家灾害管理机构 (BNPB) 周六晚将死亡人数从 40 人上调，救援官员法图尔·拉赫曼 (Fathur Ra​​hman) 表示，这场 7.7 级地震造成 50 人受伤。 BNPB 领导人苏哈扬托早些时候表示，人们被困在几栋建筑物内。 “这些将是救灾小组的首要目标，”苏哈扬托说，他和许多印度尼西亚人一样使用一个名字。 据 BNPB 报道，印度尼西亚东部这个热门旅游岛屿发生地震时，近 160 栋房屋、数十座教育和医疗设施以及其他公共建筑受损。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 红十字会与红新月会国际联合会表示，正在准备向临时避难所中的约 2000 人提供援助。 政府向该地区发送了 50,000 个总重 275 吨的援助包，欧盟主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩 (Ursula von der Leyen) 也提供了欧盟哥白尼地球观测卫星的帮助。 “欧洲随时准备部署哥白尼，我们的天空之眼，以支持搜救工作。印度尼西亚，我们与你们站在一起，”她在 X 上写道。 住在震中以西100多公里的如腾市的尤利安·朱塔·埃卡利亚（Yulian Juita Ekalia）在地震发生几小时后通过电话告诉法新社：“我从来没有感受到这么大的地震。” 这位 37 岁的大学讲师说：“感觉就像我们在蹦床上一样；真的很可怕。”他于当地时间周六凌晨 5 点 30 分左右被惊醒。 “当我冲出去时，房子里的所有东西都掉了下来：电视、我儿子的奖杯、碗碟架、衣柜顶上的手提箱。当我出去时，我儿子和邻居已经在那里，吓得尖叫起来。” 救援官员法图尔告诉法新社，重点是寻找可能被埋在瓦砾下的受害者，但由于山体滑坡切断了道路，救援工作变得更加复杂。 法新社记者目睹，周六早些时候，海水退去，靠近震中的纳格科奥地区的居民争先恐后地逃往更高的地方——这可能是海啸即将来临的迹象。 虽然海啸警报已解除，但当局敦促人们不要返回受损的建筑物，因为担心余震可能会导致建筑物倒塌。 数小时后，岛上发生了数十次余震，其中最强烈的震级为 6.1 级，数百人仍留在外面。 据印度尼西亚 BMKG 地质局称，弗洛勒斯岛一些沿海地区的波浪高达 1.6 米。

reflection.en: In the wake of such devastating loss and desperate searches, our hearts ache for those affected by the earthquake. Revelation 21:4 reminds us of Yahweh's promise to one day wipe away every tear, where death, mourning, crying, and pain will be no more. This hope offers solace even as we grieve with those who suffer today.
reflection.zh: 在这场毁灭性的灾难和绝望的搜救之后，我们的心为所有受地震影响的人而痛。启示录21:4提醒我们雅伟的应许，有一天祂将擦去所有的眼泪，不再有死亡、悲哀、哭号和疼痛。这个盼望在今天我们与受苦者一同悲伤时，提供了安慰。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: China Desk
title.zh: 中国观察

strap.en: Policy signals, social change, and national developments inside China.
strap.zh: 聚焦中国内部政策走向、社会变化与国家动态。

title.en: A fake website and a deluge of CVs: the Australian firm embroiled in an FBI probe into alleged Chinese espionage
title.zh: 虚假网站和海量简历：这家澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查

summary.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued to boast about their defence and security credentials, they became impossible to ignore. From mid-2025, a small Australian consultancy firm called Horizzen started receiving emails and strange calls from people applying for vague jobs in the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：在线冒充布里斯班公司的虚假咨询公司是美国司法部查获的 13 个网站之一 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新更新 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当第一批电子邮件到达时，它们很容易被视为垃圾邮件而被忽略。但随着陌生人继续吹嘘他们的国防和安全资历，他们变得不可能被忽视。从 2025 年中期开始，一家名为 Horizzen 的澳大利亚小型咨询公司开始收到人们在美国申请模糊工作的电子邮件和奇怪的电话。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: How to buy a ‘mega-dinghy’: the perilous new model of Channel crossing
title.zh: 如何购买“巨型橡皮艇”：危险的英吉利海峡偷渡新模式

summary.en: The Guardian China reports on the alarming trend of large dinghies, capable of carrying hundreds, being used for perilous Channel crossings. The article investigates the supply chain for these vessels, noting that large orders are readily fulfilled by manufacturers.
summary.zh: 《卫报》中国版报道称，载有数百人的大型充气艇被用于危险的英吉利海峡偷渡，这一趋势令人担忧。文章调查了这些大型船只的来源，指出制造商可以轻松满足大批量订单。

body.en: Boats carrying hundreds of people are a clear and alarming trend. But where do such large vessels come from? Providing a large dinghy for use in the choppy seas of western Europe was not a problem, as long as the order was for more than 20 vessels, they said. The sales manager at the Chinese company even had an online brochure for an undercover Guardian reporter, posing as a prospective client, to peruse. They had a production capacity of 500 boats a month and, yes, it was possible to get even bigger ones for the right price. They could do a seven or even an eight-metre military-style dinghy for $1,678 (£1,238) a boat, without the engines, but that would be lacking CE certification, the mandatory mark that shows a product meets EU health and safety requirements. Additional reporting by Lyndon Li Continue reading...
body.zh: 载有数百人的船只是一个明显且令人震惊的趋势。但这么大的船只从哪里来呢？他们表示，只要订单超过 20 艘，提供一艘在西欧波涛汹涌的海域使用的大型小艇就不成问题。这家中国公司的销售经理甚至还为一位冒充潜在客户的卫报卧底记者准备了一份在线手册供其细读。他们的生产能力为每月 500 艘船，是的，有可能以合适的价格获得更大的船。他们可以以每艘 1,678 美元（1,238 英镑）的价格制造一艘七米甚至八米长的军用小艇，不带发动机，但这将缺乏 CE 认证，这是表明产品符合欧盟健康和安全要求的强制性标志。林登·李的补充报道继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report on the supply of vessels for perilous journeys reminds us of the vulnerable individuals seeking safety and new beginnings. Yahweh calls us to recognize His presence in those who are marginalized and in desperate need. Our compassion for 'the least of these' reflects our love for Him.
reflection.zh: 这篇关于用于危险旅程的船只供应的报道，提醒我们那些寻求安全和新生活的弱势个体。雅伟呼召我们要在那些被边缘化和极度需要的人身上认出祂的存在。我们对“这些最小的弟兄”的怜悯，反映了我们对祂的爱。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: The Fauci hearing was painful to watch. But we need answers on Covid-19’s origin| David Relman
title.zh: 福奇听证会令人痛苦，但我们需要新冠病毒起源的答案 | 大卫·雷尔曼

summary.en: Despite recent congressional hearings, understanding the origin of Covid-19 remains elusive, with a microbiologist observing a deterioration in public discourse surrounding the issue.
summary.zh: 尽管近期国会举行了听证会，但了解新冠病毒的起源仍然困难重重，一位微生物学家指出，围绕这一问题的公共讨论正在恶化。

body.en: Despite the recent hearings in Congress, we seem to be even further from the goal of understanding Covid-19’s origin’s than we have ever been As a microbiologist and infectious disease clinician, it has been tough to watch the recent devolution of public discourse on Covid-19 origins. It has been especially difficult for me to read the comments of Anthony Fauci about the origins debate in his now-public diary . And it has been painful to watch the televised spectacle hosted by the US senator Rand Paul on 29 July involving a hostile interrogation of Fauci. Despite many early pleas, including my own , for a dispassionate, objective assessment of what we know, don’t know and need to know about Covid-19 origins, we seem to be even further from this goal now than we have ever been – plagued by politicization, polarization and illogical thinking. David Relman is a professor of medicine and microbiology at Stanford University. He was an inaugural member of the US National Science Advisory Board for Biosecurity and president of the Infectious Diseases Society of America Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管最近在国会举行了听证会，但我们似乎距离了解 Covid-19 起源的目标比以往任何时候都更远。作为一名微生物学家和传染病临床医生，很难看到最近公众关于 Covid-19 起源的讨论的转移。对我来说，阅读安东尼·福奇在他现已公开的日记中关于起源争论的评论尤其困难。 7 月 29 日美国参议员兰德·保罗主持的电视节目对福奇进行敌意审讯，令人感到痛苦。尽管包括我自己在内的许多人早期呼吁对我们所知道、不知道和需要了解的 Covid-19 起源进行冷静、客观的评估，但我们现在似乎比以往任何时候都离这个目标更远——受到政治化、两极分化和不合逻辑思维的困扰。大卫·雷尔曼是斯坦福大学医学和微生物学教授。他是美国国家生物安全科学咨询委员会的首任成员和美国传染病学会主席继续阅读...

reflection.en: The struggle to understand complex issues like the origin of Covid-19, especially amidst contentious public discourse, reminds us of the wisdom in seeking thorough examination. Proverbs 18:17 suggests that true understanding emerges only after hearing all sides and carefully scrutinizing every claim. This calls for patience and a commitment to truth beyond...
reflection.zh: 在围绕新冠病毒起源等复杂问题展开的激烈公共讨论中，我们努力寻求理解，这提醒我们彻底审查的重要性。箴言18:17指出，真正的理解只有在听取各方意见并仔细审查每项主张之后才能浮现。这要求我们超越初步印象，以耐心和对真理的承诺，从而走向更清晰的道路。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: ‘TikTok wouldn’t open at all’: Taiwan simulates an internet blackout, with an eye on China threat
title.zh: “抖音完全打不开”：台湾模拟互联网中断，以应对中国威胁

summary.en: Taiwan conducted its first internet blackout simulation, prompted by concerns over the security of its undersea cables, which are vital for its digital connectivity. During the exercise in Taipei, air raid sirens sounded, mobile alerts pinged, and police directed people off the streets.
summary.zh: 台湾周四首次进行互联网中断模拟演习，原因是担心作为其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全。在台北的演习中，防空警报响起，手机警报提示音不断，警察引导人们离开街道。

body.en: Taiwan practised cutting off internet for the first time amid concerns about the safety of the undersea cables that form its ‘digital lifeline’ In Taipei, the streets swiftly empty as air raid sirens ring out and alerts ping on mobile phones. Police officers usher any stragglers into shelters, leaving the capital suddenly deserted. In cities across Taiwan, these kinds of drills are a fact of life every year , amid the growing threat posed by China across the strait, but this time there is something different. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由于担心构成其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全性，台湾周四首次练习切断互联网。在台北，随着空袭警报的响起和手机上的警报声，街道迅速空无一人。警察把掉队的人带进避难所，首都突然变得空无一人。在台湾各城市，随着海峡两岸中国构成的威胁日益加剧，此类演习每年都是家常便饭，但这次有所不同。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Taiwan's simulation of an internet blackout highlights the deep anxieties nations face regarding critical infrastructure and potential threats. In moments of such vulnerability and preparation, the ancient promise of Yahweh reminds us not to fear or be dismayed, for divine presence offers strength and help. This spiritual anchor can guide communities as...
reflection.zh: 台湾模拟互联网中断，凸显了各国在关键基础设施和潜在威胁面前的深层焦虑。在面对这种脆弱和准备的时刻，雅伟的古老应许提醒我们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为神圣的同在提供力量和帮助。这个属灵的锚点可以指引社群应对复杂的挑战并建立韧性。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: The west turns a blind eye to Xi Jinping’s repressive regime in China | Letters
title.zh: 西方国家对习近平在中国的压制性政权视而不见 | 来信

summary.en: Jennifer Hubbard and other letter writers express concern that Western nations are ignoring China's repressive regime, particularly its 'ethnic unity' law used to suppress minorities. They argue that meaningful international diplomacy is urgently needed to address these human rights issues.
summary.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德及其他来信者表示，西方国家对中国压制性政权，特别是其用于压制少数民族的“民族团结”法视而不见。他们认为，急需有意义的国际外交来解决这些人权问题。

body.en: Meaningful diplomacy on an international level is well overdue, writes Jennifer Hubbard . Plus letters from Geoffrey Dixon and Jane Renton In his article on China’s latest tool for suppression of minorities, the “ethnic unity” law, Simon Tisdall seems to take it as read that western governments will continue to pay lip service to notions of human rights in China while pursuing short-term economic goals, ultimately destructive to their own productivity ( President Xi never wastes a good crisis. As Iran, Ukraine and Palestine distract the world, he tightens his grip, 8 August ). This has been the pattern since June 1989, the Tiananmen Square massacre. His faint hope that the young urban Chinese might overturn Xi’s regime is a judgment on the failure of western governments to show any foresight, integrity, effective diplomacy, joined-up thinking or action. They rely on the self-sacrifice of individuals such as Jimmy Lai , Lobga Rangzen and countless – often to us nameless – individuals who put their lives on the line while we wring our hands and weep crocodile tears. Continue reading...
body.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德写道，早就应该在国际层面开展有意义的外交。再加上杰弗里·迪克森和简·伦顿的来信。西蒙·蒂斯达尔在其关于中国镇压少数民族的最新工具“民族团结”法的文章中似乎认为，西方政府将继续对中国的人权观念口头上说好，同时追求短期经济目标，最终损害他们自己的生产力（习主席从来不会浪费一场好的危机。随着伊朗、乌克兰和巴勒斯坦分散了世界的注意力，他加强了控制，8月8日）。这就是1989年6月天安门广场屠杀以来的模式。他对中国城市年轻人可能推翻习近平政权的微弱希望是对西方政府未能表现出任何远见、正直、有效外交、联合思维或行动的判断。他们依赖于黎智英（Jimmy Lai）、洛布加·让赞（Lobga Rangzen）等个人的自我牺牲，以及无数（通常对我们来说无名）个人的自我牺牲，他们冒着生命危险，而我们则绞尽脑汁，流下鳄鱼的眼泪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call for international diplomacy to address the suppression of minorities echoes the biblical mandate to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. In a world where powerful voices can overshadow the vulnerable, Yahweh reminds us of our responsibility to advocate for justice and the rights of the destitute. May we seek wisdom and courage to uphold...
reflection.zh: 呼吁国际外交以解决少数民族受压迫的问题，与圣经中为不能为自己说话之人发声的命令不谋而合。在一个强大声音可能掩盖弱势群体的世界里，雅伟提醒我们有责任倡导正义和维护贫困者的权利。愿我们寻求智慧和勇气，维护所有人的尊严，特别是那些声音被压制的人。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Taiwan says it was hit by ‘abnormal’ AI-assisted cyber-attack
title.zh: 台湾称遭受“异常”人工智能辅助网络攻击

summary.en: Taiwan reported detecting "abnormal" AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies last month, originating from overseas. These attacks represent a new kind of threat, with suspected links to China-based hackers.
summary.zh: 台湾报告称，上个月侦测到来自海外、由人工智能辅助的“异常”网络攻击，目标是政府机构。这些攻击代表了一种新型威胁，据称与中国相关黑客有关。

body.en: Taiwan’s statement comes a day after reports that suspected China-linked hackers had carried out a first-of-a-kind breach Taiwan says it detected AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies that came from overseas last month, a new kind of threat that has been reported as “first-of-a-kind breach”. The Ministry of Digital Affairs (MDA) said its cybersecurity monitoring units ‌detected the “abnormal attack” targeting government agencies, which began on 20 July. The National Institute of Cyber Security issued a series of warning alerts while it investigated. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾发表声明的前一天，有报道称疑似与中国有关的黑客实施了史无前例的违规行为。台湾表示，上个月检测到来自海外的针对政府机构的人工智能辅助网络攻击，这是一种新的威胁，被报道为“史无前例的违规行为”。数字事务部 (MDA) 表示，其网络安全监控单位检测到 7 月 20 日开始的针对政府机构的“异常攻击”。美国国家网络安全研究所在调查过程中发布了一系列警告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The emergence of AI-assisted cyber-attacks highlights the constant need for vigilance in a rapidly changing world. Proverbs 27:12 reminds us that wisdom lies in foreseeing danger and taking appropriate refuge. As technology evolves, so must our discernment and protective measures, trusting Yahweh for guidance.
reflection.zh: 人工智能辅助的网络攻击的出现，凸显了在快速变化的世界中保持警惕的持续必要性。箴言27:12提醒我们，智慧在于预见危险并采取适当的避难措施。随着科技发展，我们的洞察力和保护措施也必须随之进步，信靠雅伟的指引。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: With Hollywood struggling in China, can the Odyssey draw a crowd?
title.zh: 好莱坞在中国市场举步维艰，《奥德赛》能否吸引观众？

summary.en: Christopher Nolan's summer blockbuster, "The Odyssey" (likely Oppenheimer), is set for release across China's Imax screens. This comes at a time when Western films generally face difficulties in the Chinese market, and the film itself has reportedly overcome significant opposition.
summary.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰的夏季大片《奥德赛》（很可能是《奥本海默》）将在中国各地的IMAX影院上映。目前西方电影在中国市场普遍举步维艰，而这部影片据报道也克服了来自世界首富的猛烈攻击。

body.en: Christopher Nolan’s epic will be released on Friday across most of the country’s 800 Imax screens, at a time when western films have been struggling The Odyssey, Christopher Nolan’s summer blockbuster juggernaut, has overcome an onslaught of attacks from the world’s richest man and stared down criticism from a classicist who translated the poem , to become one of the year’s most celebrated and highest-grossing films. But this week, the film faces one of its biggest challenges yet. Continue reading...
body.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰的这部史诗巨制将于周五在全国 800 块 Imax 银幕上上映，当时西方电影一直在苦苦挣扎，克里斯托弗·诺兰的夏季大片《奥德赛》克服了来自世界首富的猛烈攻击，也顶住了翻译这首诗的古典学家的批评，成为今年最著名和票房最高的电影之一。但本周，这部电影面临着迄今为止最大的挑战之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Launching any major endeavor, like a film in a challenging market, requires immense effort and hope for success. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our work to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans. Even when facing significant headwinds, we can find peace in knowing that our diligent efforts are seen and can be blessed.
reflection.zh: 在充满挑战的市场中推出一部电影这样的大型项目，需要付出巨大的努力并寄予成功的希望。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们的工作交托给雅伟，相信他会成就我们的计划。即使面对重重阻力，我们也能在知道自己的辛勤努力被看见并蒙福时找到平安。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Zhu Rongji obituary

summary.en: Zhu Rongji, the fifth premier of the People’s Republic of China, has passed away at 97. He was widely recognized as an economic reformer who famously declared China 'the factory of the world' and was regarded as one of the country's most effective administrators.
summary.zh: 中华人民共和国第五任总理朱镕基逝世，享年97岁。他被广泛认为是经济改革家，曾宣布中国成为‘世界工厂’，并被视为该国最有效的管理者之一。

body.en: Premier of the People’s Republic of China regarded as an economic reformer who declared that the country had become ‘the factory of the world’ Zhu Rongji, who has died aged 97, was the fifth premier of the People’s Republic of China and one of its most effective administrators and economic reformers following its foundation in 1949. In 1991, Zhu was summoned to Beijing, in the footsteps of the then president and party secretary Jiang Zemin , and in the aftermath of the 1989 uprisings in Beijing and the collapse of the Soviet Union. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中华人民共和国总理被誉为经济改革家，宣称中国已成为“世界工厂”。 朱镕基去世，享年 97 岁。朱镕基是中华人民共和国第五任总理，也是自 1949 年建国以来最有效的管理者和经济改革家之一。1991 年，朱镕基追随时任国家主席兼党委书记江泽民的脚步，在改革开放之后被召唤到北京。 1989年北京起义和苏联解体。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The passing of a leader like Zhu Rongji marks the end of a significant chapter, reflecting a life dedicated to public service and economic reform. His legacy reminds us that every life is a race run, with efforts and impacts that shape the world around us. Yahweh invites us to consider how we too might finish our own race with integrity and purpose.
reflection.zh: 朱镕基这样一位领导人的逝世，标志着一个重要篇章的结束，反映了他一生致力于公共服务和经济改革。他的遗产提醒我们，每个人的一生都是一场赛跑，其努力和影响塑造着我们周围的世界。雅伟邀请我们思考，我们又将如何以正直和目标跑完自己的赛程。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

Continue reading...

reflection.en: As Beijing faces torrential rains and evacuations, the immediate need for safety and shelter is paramount. In times of natural disaster, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Even amidst the chaos, we can find solace and resilience in His unwavering presence.
reflection.zh: 当北京面临暴雨和疏散时，对安全和庇护的即时需求至关重要。在自然灾害面前，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。即使在混乱之中，我们也能在祂坚定不移的同在中找到慰藉和韧性。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

body.en:

Aussies have long held a narrative of the resilient “battler”. But recent history suggests the days of "she'll be right," may be behind us. Insight explores whether the little Aussie battler still exists or whether a culture of complaint has taken over. Watch Insight episode Wired to Whinge Tuesday 18 August at 8.30PM on SBS or SBS On Demand.

"Whingeing shouldn't be disparaged. I think it's a right in any liberal democracy like Australia," he told Insight.

"There are laws there which have to be upheld; sometimes those laws don't function. People whinge when they don't function."

Having lived in Sydney's Inner west since immigrating from the UK a few years ago, Walter feels a sense of civic duty to the neighbourhood .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

He acted on that sense of duty most acutely a few years, taking issue with what he describes as a "problematic nightclub".

"When the club shuts down in the early hours — or late at night, rather — you've got the antisocial aspects of people slamming car doors, people shouting, people urinating in the street, people leaving bottles, cans, et cetera ... "

"People wake up to mess in the morning ... People can't sleep — it stresses people out."

Walter took the neighbourhood's noise complaints, which included a petition signed by more than 150 residents, to the Inner West Council and Liquor & Gaming NSW.

He said there is an "art" to complaining that required one to be organised and to go to the top authorities about the problem.

Alison Flett never imagined her live music venue would cause such conflict when it first opened in 2021.

She had experience running similar venues and made sure every aspect was up to standard.

"It was DA-approved. My lawyers, my town planners, my advisers said, 'You'd be mad not to take this place over'," Alison said.

It was when new government-mandated COVID-19 restrictions — including rules around physical distancing — took effect that she says venues like hers were encouraged to make use of their outdoor spaces.

While this allowed Alison's venue to continue operating, it also meant locals were more exposed to noise; and in 2023, the complaints ramped up.

Alison said one letter from the council even informed her she was on criminal notice.

body.en:
The federal government has confirmed it will slow the processing of working holiday visa applications as pressure mounts to reduce net migration numbers. 

Nine newspapers first reported on Saturday that the federal government had paused applications for working holiday visas from 24 countries.

But Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke confirmed on Sunday that working holiday visas were still being processed, but they were being handled "more slowly than they were previously".

However, when asked about the impact of fewer backpackers on the agriculture sector, he pointed to a Pacific workers' scheme as the primary visa for temporary staff.

"One of the things that happened when we started to improve worker protections on (the Pacific scheme) was ... some of the worst operators said, "if we've got to have better standards for (those) workers, we'll just switch to backpackers".

Working holiday visas — often called "backpacker visas" — allow travellers to extend their stay in Australia by undertaking work that addresses labour shortages in Australia — often fruit picking, farm work, mining, or tourism work in regional and remote areas.

The number of working holiday visa holders in Australia passed 210,000 in June 2025, outpacing pre-COVID figures by around 100,000.

The move comes as pressure builds on the Albanese government to bring down net overseas migration, with other parties carving out their migration policy.

Migration experts have warned of the dangers of political parties attempting to blame migrants for a lack of homes , arguing that migrant workforces will be essential to building the required housing stock

Net overseas migration — a measure covering visitors, family and partner visas, working holidaymakers, skilled migration, and humanitarian intake, alongside returning Australians — fell slightly to 301,000 in 2025, down from 306,000 the year before, according to the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

Labor's long-term target is 225,000 a year over the next three years, though Burke said on Sunday the party's migration policy was still being worked through and needed to go through a full cabinet process.

None of the major parties has yet specified which visa categories they'd cut to hit their targets — though the Coalition has said intake should be tied to housing competitions rather than a fixed annual figure.

title.en: Government admits NDIS reforms will impact families, downplays fears over state readiness
title.zh: 政府承认国家残疾保险计划改革将影响家庭，淡化对各州准备情况的担忧

summary.en: The federal disability minister has defended proposed changes to the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), acknowledging that the reforms will affect families. The minister also indicated that further amendments are planned to combat fraud and secure parliamentary approval.
summary.zh: 联邦残疾事务部长为国家残疾保险计划（NDIS）的改革措施进行了辩护，承认这些改革将影响到家庭。部长还表示，将进一步修订以打击欺诈行为并争取议会支持。

body.en:
Labor has downplayed concerns that state-based disability supports won't be ready when needed, as the government pushes contentious NDIS reforms targeting fraud and spending through parliament.

A government-led Senate inquiry on Friday recommended National Disability Insurance Scheme changes should be passed with no substantial alterations.

The overhaul would cut a targeted $37.8 billion from the NDIS over four years and remove 160,000 participants by tightening eligibility requirements.

NDIS Minister Jenny McAllister said a deal between the government and the coalition to pass the changes was getting close.

"We're really hopeful and I'd go as far as saying confident that we can reach an agreement," she told ABC's Insiders program on Sunday.

Opposition health spokeswoman Anne Ruston called for a strengthened fraud and corruption response within the disability insurance agency in the inquiry report.

Senator McAllister said the government was still considering evidence brought forward during the inquiry process and flagged fraud as an area to work through with the coalition.

But concerns about the changes remain among advocates — and from at least one state.

In a joint statement, 12 disability advocacy organisations said the reforms should not pass parliament in their current form.

"It must guarantee that people are not diverted from, or lose, NDIS supports unless alternative supports are funded, operational, accessible and available in practice."

Queensland has resisted signing up to the Thriving Kids program, a major plank in federal plans to cut costs from the NDIS.

Under the program, which is due to be rolled out from October, some children aged eight and under with autism or developmental delays would be shifted onto state supports.

Queensland Disability Minister Amanda Camm has refused to back the agreement, labelling the change a cost-shifting exercise that lacked detail.

Despite the conflict, Labor remained confident people with a disability would not be left without the support they needed.

"We don't need to contemplate delay at this point, because we are working with the states and territories toward that January 1 deadline."

Labor's NDIS plan would lead to average funding being cut by about $5000 a year for participants.

"It is a reduction and we don't deny that it will have impacts on people with disability and their families," Senator McAllister said.

She again dismissed calls to introduce an NDIS inspector-general, saying it would risk adding another layer of bureaucracy.

title.en: Pauline Hanson still doesn't like Mardi Gras, says sexuality should be 'behind closed doors'
title.zh: 宝琳·汉森仍不喜欢同性恋狂欢节，称性取向应“关起门来”

summary.en: Pauline Hanson reiterated her disapproval of Mardi Gras, stating that sexuality should remain a private matter. She also defended her lack of knowledge regarding the leaders of Australia's neighboring countries.
summary.zh: 宝琳·汉森重申她不喜欢同性恋狂欢节，并表示性取向应“关起门来”。她还为自己不了解邻国领导人一事进行了辩护。

body.en:
Pauline Hanson has doubled down on notorious decades-old comments criticising Sydney's Mardi Gras, saying she thinks people should keep their sexuality "behind closed doors".

The comments come only days after a colleague declared One Nation "one of the gayest parties in Australia".

In an infamous 1996 interview with 60 Minutes, the right-wing party's leader responded "I don't like it" while offering her thoughts on the annual LGBTIQ+ festival.

"I don't like it because it's promoting something ... that is not natural," she said at the time.

Her "I don't like it" comment was co-opted by drag queen Pauline Pantsdown in 1998 and remixed into a parody dance song, which made it into the Triple J Hottest 100 list of that year.

Three decades later, Senator Hanson said she acknowledged the economic benefit of the pride parade, adding that it was "acceptable" Australia had legalised gay marriage.

"I still don't like the gay Mardi Gras, but that's my opinion," she told News24 on Sunday.

"I think your own, personal sexuality should be kept ... behind closed doors. It's no one's business to do it out there with the gay Mardi Gras anywhere.

"I know it brings a lot of tourists to the country. I know it brings a lot of money. I know all this, but that’s my personal opinion. But anyway, good luck to them that they want to do that."

Her comments follow revelations One Nation's candidate for Western Australia's upper house at the 2025 election, Parminder Singh, made several anti-gay comments in a video on social media.

Mr Singh, who was third on One Nation's upper house ticket at the state election, has since been removed from the party's website, after the video became public.

During the week, One Nation MP Barnaby distanced the party from its former candidate's views, describing it as "one of the gayest parties in Australia".

Senator Hanson also rejected Ms Singh's comments, saying she never heard similar views from him when he was a candidate.

The firebrand politician also defended her inability to name the leaders of crucial allies and regional powers when questioned about her foreign policy credentials as a would-be prime minister.

In an earlier interview with News24, the One Nation leader said diplomacy with Australia's neighbours would pose "no problem", despite her notoriously using her maiden speech in 1996 to declare the nation was "in danger of being swamped by Asians".

Asked if she could name the president of Indonesia or the prime minister of Japan, two major regional powers and key Australian trading partners, Senator Hanson said she couldn't.

title.en: The new national gun buyback scheme is here. Here's the compensation on offer
title.zh: 新的全国枪支回购计划已启动。这是提供的补偿方案

summary.en: The federal and New South Wales governments have agreed on a gun buyback scheme for the state, initiated after the 2025 Bondi shooting massacre.
summary.zh: 联邦政府和新南威尔士州政府已就该州的枪支回购计划达成协议，此举是在2025年邦迪枪击案大屠杀之后启动的。

body.en:
An agreement has been struck on a major federal-state gun buyback following the Bondi shooting massacre, with the Commonwealth and New South Wales governments to evenly share the cost of the scheme.

NSW tightened its laws in the days following the December 2025 attack by introducing gun ownership limits, reclassifying some types of weapons, boosting background checks and reducing firearms licences from five years to two.

The buyback is now considered the next step in the reforms — and is informed by the interim recommendations of the anti-Semitism royal commission.

"We must do everything we can to make sure the anti-Semitic terrorist attack in Bondi doesn't happen again," Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Sunday.

But the hope for a truly national scheme is far from certain. NSW is so far the only state to come aboard, with several states rejecting joining outright — and it also faces mounting opposition from political parties, including One Nation.

The first phase of the scheme, set to begin on 2 November 2026, will see $1,000 paid to people who hand in their revolvers, $850 for semi-automatic handguns, $850 for double-barrel shotguns and $650 for those with a single barrel.

Compensation will be paid for firearms beyond the new ownership limits and for newly reclassified firearms, along with a flat fee for associated ammunition.

The scheme will also provide financial assistance for businesses and industry to adjust to the reforms.

The Commonwealth will contribute 50 per cent for administration costs and fully fund the destruction of surrendered weapons. 

A fixed price schedule will apply for individual licence holders beyond the new legal limit to return their firearms in exchange for compensation.

Eligible businesses and dealers will be offered up to $25,000 in grants and one-off licence fee relief worth $500 over two years per dealer.

Early 2027 will see a pathway to compensation, for a fee, for eligible higher-value firearms with an indicative market value above $3,000 and capped at $10,000 per firearm.

It's estimated up to 274,000 registered firearms or about 24 per cent of the total number of registered guns in NSW — and some 50,000 licence holders — are affected by the new limits on ownership. 

The buyback scheme has been branded a national one — though NSW is the only state participating right now.

Queensland and Victoria have rejected the scheme outright, while the NT was firm that it would not fund a buyback.

reflection.en: In the wake of tragic violence, societies often grapple with how to prevent future harm. Jesus' words remind us of the destructive cycle that weapons can perpetuate, urging us to consider ways to disarm rather than escalate. A gun buyback scheme, though a governmental response, reflects a communal desire to break this cycle and foster a safer environment...
reflection.zh: 在悲剧性暴力事件之后，社会常常努力思考如何防止未来的伤害。耶稣的话语提醒我们武器可能造成的破坏性循环，敦促我们思考如何解除武装而非升级冲突。枪支回购计划，虽然是政府的回应，却反映了社区打破这一循环、为所有人创造更安全环境的共同愿望。
